name: install-tl-unx
title: install-tl-unx
summary: The TeX Live package is a comprehensive TeX document production system. It includes TeX, LaTeX2e, LuaLaTeX, Metafont, MetaPost, BibTeX and many other programs; an extensive collection of macros, fonts and documentation; and support for typesetting in many different scripts from around the world.
disk_space: 90 MB for plain TeX, typically 323 MB for latex and later engines, 9.0 GB if everything is included
build_time: varies, depending on network speed and traffic
